arStrings.szText: Enter the chamber at the northern edge of the Temple of Life
Enter the chamber at the northern edge of the Temple of Life

With Tharra's help, we have cleared away much of the corruption from the Temple of Life. All that remains is a chamber at the northern edge of the structure. That is where this darkness is spreading from...and that is where I must go to root it out for good.
